scenario.fault_family: BGP config error (wrong remote-as on a neighbor)
scenario.prompt_to_agent:
Since a config push this morning, the BGP session between
spine_router_0_1 and leaf_router_0_1 will not come up: it cycles
without ever reaching Established, and the leaf's log shows its OPEN
being rejected by the spine with an AS error. Every other session in
the fabric is Established, all interfaces are UP, and users report at
most a brief blip -- pc_0_0 (10.0.0.2) and pc_0_1 (10.0.1.2) still
reach each other. Find the fault.

injection.action: misconfigure the remote-as of the leaf_router_0_1 neighbor

scenario.ground_truth:
Affected component: spine_router_0_1 BGP neighbor remote-as
Mechanism: spine_router_0_1 (AS 65101) peers with leaf_router_0_1 at
  172.16.0.11, whose real AS is 65201. The neighbor statement was
  changed to `remote-as 65999`, so when the leaf's OPEN arrives
  announcing AS 65201, spine_router_0_1 rejects it with an OPEN error
  (Bad Peer AS) notification and the session can never establish --
  it cycles between Idle/Active/OpenSent. The CLOS fabric is
  redundant: leaf_router_0_1 still peers with spine_router_0_0, so
  both host prefixes stay reachable and the impact is loss of the
  second spine path for leaf_router_0_1, not an outage.
Localization: spine_router_0_1 (the misconfigured side; leaf_router_0_1's
  own config is unchanged and correct)
Root cause: neighbor 172.16.0.11 configured with remote-as 65999
  instead of 65201 on spine_router_0_1
Fix: set the neighbor's remote-as back to 65201 on spine_router_0_1
  (see [FIX]).
scenario.fix_spec:
Correct the remote-as on spine_router_0_1:
`vtysh -c "configure terminal" -c "router bgp 65101"
 -c "neighbor 172.16.0.11 remote-as 65201"`
Note: the injection changed only the running config; the intended
config is still intact in /etc/frr/frr.conf, so `service frr restart`
on spine_router_0_1 is an equally correct fix.

must-distinguish-symptom-pattern: only the spine_router_0_1 <-> leaf_router_0_1 session is affected while links are UP and all other sessions are Established

bonus-exonerates-leaf: notes leaf_router_0_1's own configuration is correct/unchanged, so the misconfiguration is on the spine side

agent.diagnosis_text:
Affected component: FRR BGP neighbor configuration on spine_router_0_1. The BGP session on the leaf side (leaf_router_0_1) remains Idle because the spine rejects the OPEN due to an AS number mismatch.

Mechanism: When leaf_router_0_1 (AS 65201) sends an OPEN to spine_router_0_1 over the 172.16.0.10/31–172.16.0.11/31 link, the spine expects the peer to be AS 65999. FRR detects the remote-AS in the OPEN does not match its configured neighbor remote-as and responds with a NOTIFICATION (AS error), causing the session to reset and cycle without reaching Established.

Localization: The misconfiguration is on spine_router_0_1 for neighbor 172.16.0.11. Evidence:
- spine_router_0_1 running-config: “neighbor 172.16.0.11 remote-as 65999”
- spine_router_0_1 “show ip bgp summary”: neighbor 172.16.0.11 AS 65999, State Idle
- leaf_router_0_1 running-config: “neighbor 172.16.0.10 remote-as 65101” (correct for the spine’s local AS 65101), and summary shows Idle toward 172.16.0.10.

Root cause: An incorrect remote-as (65999) was configured on spine_router_0_1 for neighbor 172.16.0.11 during the morning config push.

Corrective fix: On spine_router_0_1, change the neighbor to the correct remote AS 65201:
- vtysh: configure terminal; router bgp 65101; no neighbor 172.16.0.11 remote-as 65999; neighbor 172.16.0.11 remote-as 65201; end; clear ip bgp 172.16.0.11. The session should establish, restoring full redundancy (users were unaffected due to alternate path via spine_router_0_0).

per_axis.rationale: The report explicitly names spine_router_0_1 as the misconfigured device and localizes the BGP neighbor error to that device.

per_axis.rationale: The report explicitly states leaf_router_0_1's config is correct (shows neighbor remote-as 65101) and localizes the misconfiguration to spine_router_0_1's neighbor 172.16.0.11 remote-as 65999.
The agent proposes changing the neighbor remote-as to 65201 on spine_router_0_1 (and clearing the BGP session), which matches the expected fix and will restore the session.
